English: Wrestling Patch
A rough patch of earth, cleared for basic training and wrestling matches among the tribes youth.
Stick-Fighting Ring
A crude ring marked by stones and scattered logs, where warriors hone skill and discipline with wooden weapons.
Mounted Games Yard
A field cleared for contests of horsemanship, racing, and mock combat atop steeds.
Duelists Pavilion
A large tented structure for organized duels and advanced martial training, surrounded by onlookers and officials.
Combat Circle
A permanent circle of trampled earth, ringed by wooden rails, used for large-scale martial displays and group tactics training.
Instructors Platform
A raised wooden dais, surrounded by multiple training pits, where veteran instructors teach discipline and advanced tactics.
Apprentice Arena
A full arena of sturdy timber, with stands for spectators and multiple rings for training younger warriors and future commanders.
Champions Ground
A grand, fenced expanse with dedicated training quarters, reserved for the greatest champions and elite warriors of the horde.
Strategists Hall
A fortified wood-and-clay longhouse, housing war councils and tactical games, where battle plans are drawn and field leaders are trained.
Steppe Warrior Academy
A sprawling complex of stone, timber, and felt, the heart of martial prowess for the entire clan. Here, warriors, commanders, and tacticians are trained to lead the horde to glory.
